QuestInfo.name: Hands-on Learning
QuestInfo.0: You recover the stolen ingredients, but the thief still needs to be taught a lesson.
QuestInfo.1: It looks like Anzu collected the rest of the ingredients.
QuestInfo.2: Before you could learn more about the boy, he ran off.

0.msg: Here, I've brought you every stupid thing you asked for, and now I'm done. Bye. I wish I'd never met you!\r\n

1.msg: Hey, where do you think you're going? This is the beginning of a beautiful friendship! From now on, you're my number two.\r\n

2.msg: If you think this is going to be the last time we meet, you're sorely mistaken. We'll see each other again real soon.

0.msg: What a scaredy-cat... ah, I'm sure I'll see him again. This town's so small, he can't avoid me. And when that happens, he'll regret running away!\r\n
Not one peep! Now get the rest of what we need for dinner, and I might consider being forgiving.\r\n
